'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] capture the [[front line]] village of Piatykhatky in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]] as heavy fighting continues. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-forces-take-control-piatykhatky-village-zaporizhzhia-front-russian-2023-06-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed and 28 others are reported missing after heavy rains cause [[flash flood]]s across [[Nepal]]. [https://www.sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2023/06/19/Death-toll-rises-six-in-Nepal-floods-and-landslides (Sharjah24)]
*[[Titan submersible implosion]]
**Five people are killed when an [[OceanGate]] submersible implodes during a commercial trip to the [[wreck of the Titanic]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/66015811 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 DuPage County shooting]]
**A person is killed and 22 more injured during a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Juneteenth]] celebration in [[Willowbrook, DuPage County, Illinois|Willowbrook]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/20-people-shot-1-fatally-juneteenth-celebration-chicago/story?id=100177397 (ABC News)]
*Fourteen people die from drinking [[Moonshine|bootleg alcohol]] in [[Alborz province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-bootleg-alcohol-deaths/32464460.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Malian constitutional referendum]]
**[[Malians]] head to the polls to vote on a [[referendum]] that, among other things, would enhance the powers of the [[President of Mali|President]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/18/malis-military-rulers-hold-constitutional-referendum-vote (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Kuwaiti general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Kuwait|Kuwaiti Prime Minister]] [[Ahmad Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah]] forms a new [[Cabinet of Kuwait|cabinet]] following his reappointment, appointing [[Ahmed Al-Fahad Al-Ahmed Al-Sabah]] as the [[Ministry of Defense (Kuwait)|defense minister]] and [[Saad Al Barrak]] as the [[Ministry of Oil (Kuwait)|oil minister]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/kuwait-appoints-new-oil-defence-ministers-in-latest-cabinet (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022–23 PGA Tour]]
**In [[golf]], American [[Wyndham Clark]] wins the [[2023 U.S. Open (golf)|2023 U.S. Open]], his first [[Men's major golf championships|major championship]], after shooting a final-round 70 to finish at 10-under-[[Par (score)|par]] and holding off four-time major champion [[Rory McIlroy]] of [[Northern Ireland]]. Clark had never finished better than 75th in a major championship and had missed the cut in his previous two [[U.S. Open (golf)|U.S. Open]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/golf/65946664 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2022–23 UEFA Nations League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Spain national football team|Spain]] defeat [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] 5–4 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]], after a 0–0 draw, in the [[2023 UEFA Nations League Final|final]] held at the [[De Kuip]] in [[Rotterdam]], [[Netherlands]], to win their first [[UEFA Nations League]] championship. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65944659 (BBC)]
*[[2022–23 CONCACAF Nations League]]
**In association football, the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]] defeat [[Canada men's national soccer team|Canada]] 2–0 in the [[2023 CONCACAF Nations League final|final]] held at [[Allegiant Stadium]] in [[Paradise, Nevada|Paradise]], [[Nevada]], United States, to win their second [[CONCACAF Nations League]] championship. [[Christian Pulisic]] is named the tournament's "[[Most valuable player|best player]]". [https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/football/us-beat-canada-2-0-to-win-concacaf-nations-league-8671842/ (AP via ''The Indian Express'')]
